title: Elgar - Nimrod (from "Enigma Variations")
summary: Daniel Barenboim conducts the Chicago Symphony Orchestra in Elgar's Nimrod from the Enigma Variations, opening the 1997 season at Carnegie Hall in tribute to Sir Georg Solti.
why: Shared as an evocative piece, and linked in jokes and tangents about the word Nimrod and pi's digits.

quote.text: Not a huge Elgar fan but Nimrod and many of his pieces are very evocative.
